**The fix:** in `src/routeplan/scheduling.py`, `generate_checkpoints` looped `range(n_legs)`, which returns one checkpoint per leg. A leg is the span between two checkpoints, so n legs need n+1 checkpoints (start plus each boundary). The change is one line:

```python
for i in range(n_legs + 1):
```

The four failing tests were the only ones touching this function, and the existing assertions (including the end-time check at `start + 135 min`) match the corrected behavior.
